facts.title: Tomato Jam and Mozzarella Panini
ingredients: 2 pints (about 1 ½ pounds or 4 cups) cherry tomatoes, grape tomatoes or Sungold tomatoes, halved crosswise
Several twists freshly ground black pepper
4 to 6 fresh basil leaves, torn into small pieces
Olive oil or butter, for frying
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
